test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Changing secret and coded messages in a readable form
solution: The correct answer is: **Decoding**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Decoding **means changing secret and coded messages into a readable form. (गुप्त और कोडित संदेशों को पठनीय रूप में बदलना) • It is a process opposite to encoding. • **Example**: *The spy had to decode the message to understand the enemy's plan.* *​*Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Decoupling **means separating or disconnecting something. (किसी चीज़ को अलग करना या अलग करना) • **Encoding **means converting information into code to keep it secret. (जानकारी को गुप्त रखने के लिए उसे कोड में परिवर्तित करना) • **Encrypting **means converting information into a secret code to protect it from unauthorized access. (जानकारी को अनधिकृत पहुंच से बचाने के लिए उसे गुप्त कोड में परिवर्तित करना) 17a:T560,The erroneous spelling is: **Modal**.
